name: Starlink Mobile (Direct to Cell)
spectrum: In use: partner MNO bands (T-Mobile PCS G block in US). Owned/pending: AWS-4 (2000-2020/2180-2200 MHz), H-block, unpaired AWS-3 (1695-1710 MHz), 800 MHz from Grain (pending), AWS-3 1695-1700 MHz from Tristar (62 counties)
partners: T-Mobile (US) and carriers in ~30 countries; AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile have declined wholesale/MVNO for a standalone SpaceX service
satellites: ~650 Gen-1 D2C in orbit; up to 15,000 next-gen authorized (Oct 2026)
status: Commercial via partners (text, selected app data, limited voice); ~22M monthly users Q3 2026; next-gen launches 2027, expanded service end-2027; stated aim to become a full US mobile operator
capacity: Gen-1 limited to ~5 MHz; next-gen targets ~20x per-satellite throughput, >100x system, ~150 Mbps per user
value: IPO Jun 2026 at ~$1.77T; $17B EchoStar deal; ~$8B Grain deal (reported)

name: AST SpaceMobile
spectrum: Partner low-band (e.g., AT&T, Verizon 850 MHz); Ligado L-band + 1670-1675 MHz (North America); global S-band priority rights (1980-2010/2170-2200 MHz)
partners: AT&T, Verizon (beta service); Vodafone and Rakuten per prior reporting (not reverified this session)
satellites: 12 operating (Nov 2026); ~45 targeted by mid-2027; >100 under launch contracts 2027-2028
status: Intermittent nationwide US service targeted before YE2026; Brazil authorization; AT&T ground-space beam handovers validated
capacity: Large phased arrays; broadband claims not independently verified; constellation too small for continuous service until ~45+
value: Cash ~$3.2B (Q3 2026); market cap ~$24.6-37.9B (Jun-Jul 2026); FY2026 revenue guidance $150-200M

name: Globalstar (being acquired by Amazon)
spectrum: Big LEO MSS L-band uplink / S-band downlink (harmonized globally) (~25 MHz)
partners: Apple (20% equity, $1.1B cash commitment, 85% of capacity)
satellites: Legacy LEO constellation plus Apple-funded replacements (count not reverified)
status: Powers iPhone/Apple Watch satellite messaging and SOS; FCC approved Amazon deal 2026-10-27; close 2027

name: Amazon Leo (D2D)
spectrum: Will inherit Globalstar MSS spectrum on closing (~25 (pending) MHz)
partners: Apple (Amazon Leo to power iPhone and Apple Watch satellite services)
satellites: 0 D2D in orbit; application for up to 5,105 D2D satellites under review

name: Iridium NTN Direct (being acquired by Rocket Lab)
satellites: Existing operational LEO fleet (~66; not reverified)
status: NTN Direct commercial for DT IoT in Q4 2026; Rocket Lab deal closing mid-2027

name: Viasat / Inmarsat
spectrum: Global L-band MSS (shared band); EU 2 GHz S-band MSS (2x15 MHz, licence expires 2027; not reverified)
partners: Space42 (Equatys D2D venture per prior reporting, not reverified); disputes AST/Ligado L-band rights outside North America
status: D2D plans via Equatys not reverified this session
capacity: GEO link budgets limit handset data rates

name: Skylo
spectrum: No owned spectrum; uses partners' licensed MSS L-band (0 owned MHz)
partners: Handset and carrier partners per prior reporting (e.g., Google Pixel, Verizon); not reverified
status: Commercial narrowband SOS/messaging (not reverified this session)

name: T-Mobile T-Satellite
spectrum: PCS G block shared with SpaceX under SCS (10 (2x5) MHz)
status: Commercial since Jul 2025; texting, MMS, selected apps; T-Mobile says it will not lease capacity to SpaceX for a competing service
